edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with liquidityWallet to authorise disabling the dev fee, bypassing the onlyOwner pattern.
msg.sender is checked against the blacklist mapping inside _transfer.
tx.origin is written into the ProcessedDividendTracker event, relying on an insecure origin value.
_transfer emits ProcessedDividendTracker with tx.origin after the tracker call.
block.timestamp is supplied as the Uniswap swap deadline, making execution time miner dependent.
block.timestamp is supplied as the Uniswap swap deadline, making execution time miner dependent.
canAutoClaim compares block.timestamp with the stored claim time.
processAccount records block.timestamp as the last claim time.
Any caller can invoke setDividendTokenAddress and replace the dividend token used for payouts.
The freely configurable dividendToken is the target of the external ERC20 transfer, so a malicious token can re-enter.
_withdrawDividendOfUser performs an external token transfer whose return value is trusted to finalise accounting.
swapAndSendToDev pushes ETH to a fixed address using transfer inside the _transfer flow.
The locally computed newBalance is the exact ETH amount pushed out to the dev address.
The computed withdrawable dividend is the amount sent in the external token transfer.
The sell path in _transfer calls swapAndSendToDev during liquidation.
_transfer calls swapAndSendDividends for the remaining contract balance.
swapAndSendDividends first calls swapTokensForDividendToken.
swapAndSendDividends forwards swapped tokens to the tracker and triggers distribution.
_transfer invokes dividendTracker.process which re-enters the main contract through holder claims.
_transfer calls dividendTracker.setBalance, an external contract call executed after token movement.
The process loop calls processAccount for every eligible holder.
setBalance triggers processAccount for the touched account.
processAccount invokes _withdrawDividendOfUser to compute and pay the dividend.
processDividendTracker calls the tracker process loop with attacker supplied gas.
claim forwards msg.sender to processAccount on the tracker.
recoverTokens moves tokens out of the contract using the internal transfer path.
setswapEnabled writes the _swapEnabled flag.
settradingEnabled writes the tradingEnabled flag.
enableDisableDevFee writes the _swapEnabled flag.
Authorisation for enableDisableDevFee compares msg.sender directly with liquidityWallet.
_swapEnabled gates the liquidation block inside _transfer.
tradingEnabled gates fee taking and liquidation inside _transfer.
_maxBuyEnabled gates the maximum transaction amount check.
liquidateTokensAtAmount is the threshold compared with the contract token balance.
_transfer sets and clears the liquidating guard around the swap sequence.
_transfer reads gasForProcessing when calling the tracker.
updateGasForProcessing writes gasForProcessing.
The constructor deploys and stores the XRPUDividendTracker.
The constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair.

swapTokensForEth calls the router with block.timestamp as the deadline.

setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private helper.
The process loop accumulates gasUsed from gasleft deltas.
The process loop advances the local _lastProcessedIndex cursor.
The local index is written back to lastProcessedIndex after the loop.
The to parameter flows into XRPU._transfer.
The amount parameter flows into XRPU._transfer.
The account parameter is written into the blacklist mapping.
The newValue parameter sets gasForProcessing.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter has no standalone security meaning and is only consumed by the core transfer function.
The amount parameter only feeds the fee, limit and transfer logic of the core function.
The blacklisted address parameter is fully handled by the core blacklisting function.
The new gas value parameter is only used to write the core state variable through the setter.
The account parameter determines the payout target inside the core claim function.
The gas budget parameter only constrains the core processing loop.
The balance parameter is only consumed by the core balance synchronisation function.
The token amount parameter is only used by the core swap-and-send function.
The user parameter is the recipient used by the unsafe external token transfer.
The pair parameter only feeds the core AMM pair setter.
The local ETH amount is the value pushed out by the unsafe native transfer.
The local dividend amount is the value moved by the unsafe ERC20 transfer.
The local contract balance is only used to branch inside the core transfer function.
The local cursor only tracks loop progress inside the core processing function.
The local gas accumulator only governs loop iteration inside the core processing function.
